title: Gate action and timer side effects with resolved consent
scope: Carry exact owned stored consent plus restrictive cookie/event hints through shared action processing on session/DO hosts before behavioral storage, capture, outcome/learning, regional fan and configured ODP egress. Event hints cannot enable consent; explicit preference changes can. Use existing personalizes semantics for action/alarm private updates and ODP qualification/profile work, preserving tracking-authorized measurement. Guard the existing DO alarm continuation without altering necessary retention cleanup/expiry policy; reuse loaded session state and successful writes rather than adding a resolver RPC.
non_goals: Not full W05/F05/F10/N06/N11/N12 closure: other ingress/sort/telemetry/logs/snapshot disclosure/SDK automatic collection, global absent-policy, consent epoch/cross-tab/revocation, historical erasure and human D03/D06 remain open. Existing necessary retention cleanup/expiry/defaults are not changed or accepted here.

Do not repair the DO normalizeEvent geo-drop as incidental work or claim a route no-op proves regional consent. Direct actual-reducer controls may exercise that guard. Tracking-only permitted measurement remains distinct from personalization.

No scoring, registry/tenant redesign, new store/binding/consent RPC, SDK/source/build/native socket/harness/framework/whole-tree retest, deployment/cloud/credential/customer-data/staging/commit/push/destructive/unrelated changes. Root alone owns governance.

criteria.description: Actual owned action routes and shared DO reducer resolve strict stored state and false-only hints before effects. Tracking false (either personalization value), blocked/absent/true cookies, event true over stored false and malformed/read/persist errors cannot produce behavioral/profile/visit/ring state, private update, capture, outcome/learning, configured ODP seed/event/profile or region work. Necessary refusal writes are separate; error/malformed or dropped DO envelopes cannot silently authorize capture.

All four switch combinations have configured-destination positive/negative controls: tracking-on measurement is preserved when personalization alone is off; action/alarm private updates and ODP qualification/profile work require both switches. Explicit successful preference enablement still works. Serialized DO WS ingress and pending alarm honor withdrawal; necessary retention branch is preserved separately. Region proof uses actual reducer geo input rather than the unchanged route geo-drop. Observe scoped session I/O reuse without claiming latency/SLO or atomic authority.

Independent frozen actual before/current source, fixture assertions, baseline and full worker outputs reviewed with exact K1 rerun; app noEmit and scoped diff pass inspected. Exact relevant source/configuration/evidence pins verified; no blanket SDK/native/historical reruns. Root separately accepts only bounded consent-effect containment and records residual/next action.
